name: bb-income-tax
description: Barbados personal income tax for income year 2026, for employees, pensioners and the self-employed. Covers the BBD 25,000 personal allowance (the 2026 band rates in BRA's policy note are held as not yet confirmed until the amending Act is found), who must file, the 30 April return in TAMIS, self-employed prepayments of 25% in June, September and December, PAYE, the reverse tax credit, NIS for the self-employed (17% to the BBD 64,320 ceiling plus 0.25% Resilience and Regeneration Fund) and withholding at 15% for non-treaty non-residents. Trigger on Barbados income tax, BRA, TAMIS, PIT Barbados, self-employed Barbados, personal allowance Barbados. Built from BRA and NIS pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
